nodes.name: Chemical reduction deposition
nodes.procedure: Au@Cu₂O core@shell nanostructures were prepared by depositing a thin layer of Cu₂O on the preformed citrate-stabilized 15 nm-sized Au nanoparticles in a chemical reduction process.
nodes.source_text: First, Au@Cu₂O core@shell nanostructures were prepared by depositing a thin layer of Cu₂O on the preformed citrate-stabilized 15 nm-sized Au nanoparticles in a chemical reduction process.[35]

nodes.name: Sulfurization transformation
nodes.procedure: Upon a sulfurization treatment, the deposited Cu₂O was transformed into Cu₇S₄. The transformation from Cu₂O into Cu₇S₄ was accompanied by the generation of structural voids.
nodes.source_text: Upon a sulfurization treatment, the deposited Cu₂O was transformed into Cu₇S₄. The transformation from Cu₂O into Cu₇S₄ was accompanied by the generation of structural voids.

nodes.name: Cation exchange
nodes.procedure: Further transformation of Cu₇S₄ into NiSₓ was achieved by conducting a cation exchange reaction between the copper and nickel cations in the presence of tributylphosphine as the coordination reagent.
